mapper.sql: id, job_type, status, target_type, target_id, requested_by, attempt, worker_id, lease_token, claimed_at, heartbeat_at, started_at, finished_at, error_code, error_summary, request_payload::text AS request_payload, created_at, updated_at
id, job_id, item_key, item_type, target_type, target_id, status, retry_count, error_code, error_summary, checkpoint::text AS checkpoint, checkpoint_attempt, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO admin_job ( job_type, target_type, target_id, requested_by, request_payload ) VALUES ( #{jobType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{requestedBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, CAST(#{requestPayloadJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING
SELECT FROM admin_job_item WHERE job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ingest_run WHERE status IN ('RUNNING', 'DEFERRED') ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM admin_job WHERE job_type IN ( 'SOURCE_DELETE', 'DOCUMENT_DELETE', 'DOCUMENT_REINDEX' ) AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') ) )
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_job SET status = 'CANCELLED', finished_at = now(), error_code = NULL, error_summary = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE job_type = 'EMBEDDING_REBUILD' AND target_id = #{configurationId} AND status = 'QUEUED'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM admin_job job INNER JOIN model_configuration configuration ON configuration.id = job.target_id WHERE job.job_type = 'EMBEDDING_REBUILD' AND configuration.model_kind = 'EMBEDDING' AND configuration.status = 'PENDING' AND job.status IN ( 'QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS' ) )

WITH candidate AS ( SELECT id FROM admin_job WHERE status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ) UPDATE admin_job job SET status = 'RUNNING', worker_id = #{workerId}, lease_token = CAST(#{leaseToken,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid), claimed_at = now(), heartbeat_at = now(), started_at = now(), updated_at = now() FROM candidate WHERE job.id = candidate.id RETURNING job.id, job.attempt, job.worker_id, job.lease_token
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_job SET status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, error_summary = #{errorSummary,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, finished_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND attempt = #{attempt} AND lease_token = CAST(#{leaseToken,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid)
mapper.select: UPDATE admin_job SET status = 'QUEUED', attempt = attempt + 1, worker_id = NULL, lease_token = NULL, claimed_at = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_summary = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS') RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_job_item SET status = 'QUEUED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_code = NULL, error_summary = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'FAILED', 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS')
mapper.select: UPDATE admin_job SET status = 'FAILED', worker_id = NULL, lease_token = NULL, finished_at = now(), error_code = 'LEASE_EXPIRED', error_summary = 'Lease expired', updated_at = now() WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND heartbeat_at < now() - CAST(#{timeout,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS interval) RETURNING

INSERT INTO admin_job_item ( job_id, item_key, item_type, target_type, target_id ) SELECT #{jobId}, #{itemKey}, #{itemType}, #{targetType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{targetId,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM admin_job WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND attempt = #{attempt} AND lease_token = CAST(#{leaseToken,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid) ) ON CONFLICT (job_id, item_key) DO UPDATE SET item_type = EXCLUDED.item_type, target_type = EXCLUDED.target_type, target_id = EXCLUDED.target_id, updated_at = now() RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_job_item item SET status = #{status}, checkpoint = CAST(#{checkpointJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), checkpoint_attempt = #{attempt}, error_code = NULL, error_summary = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE item.id = #{itemId} AND item.job_id = #{jobId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM admin_job job WHERE job.id = #{jobId} AND job.status = 'RUNNING' AND job.attempt = #{attempt} AND job.lease_token = CAST(#{leaseToken,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid) )
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM admin_job WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND attempt = #{attempt} AND lease_token = CAST(#{leaseToken,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid) FOR UPDATE
